ValidationRule.description: Prevents users from leaving the 'Onboarding Verification Failed Reason' empty when Case status is 'Failed (OK)'
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c ), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Fraud_Check", RecordType.DeveloperName = "ID_Ops_Assistance" ), ISPICKVAL( Status, "Failed (OK)" ), ISPICKVAL(OnboardingVerificationFailedReason__c, '') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: 'Onboarding Verification Failed Reason' field cannot be empty for status 'Failed (OK)'
